name: rollin
about: rollin's own sizes. Colour, type, spacing, radius and motion come from sm-core (vendor/sm-core/sm-core.css); this file only holds what the core doesn't. Each token becomes a --rollin-* variable.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, preset and menu rows.

tokens.name: size-roll-row
tokens.usage: One roll in the log (30px compact).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Character rail; becomes a slide-over below 960px window width.

tokens.name: size-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette width: 36rem, keeping 1rem each side on a phone.

tokens.name: size-palette-offset
tokens.usage: Command palette's distance from the top of the window.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: Settings dialog width: 24rem, keeping 1rem each side on a phone.

tokens.name: size-slide-over
tokens.usage: Character slide-over width; leaves a strip of the page showing.

tokens.name: size-result-cells
tokens.usage: Narrowest the dice cells in a result get before the total wraps below them.
